location_description: Mount Pocono is a borough in Monroe County, Pennsylvania. It is located nearly centered in the southernmost county of five in the northeastern corner that are part of the Pocono Mountains.  The borough serves as a local highway nexus, and sees a lot of tourist traffic making use of resources in the region.
